## Changes Made

Modified `/testbed/packages/macro/src/macroJs.ts` to support calling the `t` macro as a function with a MessageDescriptor object.

```javascript
t({ id: 'msgId', message: 'text' })
```

```javascript
  message: '{count, plural, one {One item} other {{count} items}}',

})

```
